description.ru: Работа в редакторе Unreal Engine 5: организация Content Browser, World Partition и Data Layers, Nanite/Lumen, освещение и постпроцессинг, Sequencer, импорт ассетов (FBX/glTF, текстуры, аудио), Level Streaming, cook/package/build, работа с Source Control (Perforce/Git LFS).
description.en: Working inside the Unreal Engine 5 editor: Content Browser layout, World Partition and Data Layers, Nanite/Lumen, lighting and post-process, Sequencer, asset import (FBX/glTF, textures, audio), Level Streaming, cook/package/build, and Source Control (Perforce/Git LFS).
